description: Create an event queue: it stores the chosen events (message.received, message.bounced, booking events, reply.overdue and the rest of the webhook events) for you to read with your API key, so no public URL is needed. It only gets events that happen after it is created. Up to 10 per organization. There is no update: delete and recreate to change a filter.

allowed_senders.description: Queue message.received only from these senders. Each entry is an address (jane@customer.com) or a domain (customer.com) that matches that exact domain, not its subdomains. At most 100. Omit or pass null for every sender.

authenticated_senders_only.description: Skip message.received events whose sender_authenticated is false.

domain_ids.description: Only queue events for these domain IDs and their mailboxes.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If omitted, the MCP server generates one for POST tools.

include_reply_text.description: Add reply_text, the sender's new text without quoted history, to message.received events. Needs the messages:read scope.

mailbox_ids.description: Only queue events for these mailbox IDs (plus mailboxes of domain_ids). Omit for every mailbox. Organization events are always queued.

name: shipmail_create_event_queue

allowed_senders.description: Addresses and domains message.received is limited to. Null when every sender is kept.

authenticated_senders_only.description: True when message.received is skipped when sender_authenticated is false.

include_reply_text.description: True when message.received events carry reply_text.

title: Create Event Queue
